injuries.name: Matias Maccelli
injuries.note: Maccelli wore a red no-contact jersey during the morning skate, and he will miss his ninth straight game against San Jose on Monday. It's still unclear when he will return to the lineup, but he will need to be activated from injured reserve once he receives the green light to play. Maccelli has two goals, six points and 13 shots on net in eight appearances this season.

injuries.name: Mathew Barzal
injuries.note: The fact that Barzal is traveling with the team was good news to begin with, but it seems the veteran will be back sooner rather than later. In 81 regular-season games last year, the British Columbia native game up just one tally shy of the 20-goal mark, tallying 19 goals and 53 helpers, including 20 power-play points. With his lengthy absence, Barzal is unlikely to repeat that level of production in 2026-27.

injuries.name: Quentin Musty
injuries.note: It was relayed Sept. 17 that Musty will be out long term due to his upper-body injury, so his placement on IR-NR doesn't come as a surprise. The 21-year-old had a relatively solid first full season with AHL San Jose in 2025-26, accounting for 21 goals, 45 points and a minus-14 rating over 61 regular-season games. The left-shot winger will likely continue his development with the Barracuda once he moves past his injury.

injuries.name: Kyle Keyser
injuries.note: The Sharks announced in mid-September that Keyser was facing a long-term absence due to an upper-body injury, so his placement on non-roster injured reserve isn't particularly surprising. Once he's cleared to return, the 27-year-old will likely report to AHL San Jose.
